title: GNSS: dissect Galileo SAR Short-RLM
description: Re-assemble and dissect Galileo E1-B I/NAV SAR Return Link Messages (RLMs).

notes.body: Should this be passed on in user_data instead?

I need some more explanation here.

My objective is to pass some data from the UBX dissector to the Galileo I/NAV dissector. By the documentation in proto_data.h, p_add_proto_data() is meant to support this use case.

I assume that your proposal is to pass the data directly via dissector_try_uint_with_data(). Is that understanding correct?
I don't have any preference how to pass the data. Please let me know which approach would be preferred.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17951/diffs?diff_id=1185792378&start_sha=c124e87f1929c3987feaab2940d01e4aa6ed7167#4e2b7cbecd5d0f6d33430fbae345ed38a89ad0a3_1760_1758)
Passing the SV ID now via dissector_try_uint_with_data().
This could be fetched once for all in the proto_reg_handoff_ubx_gal_inav() function instead retrieving it for each packet.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17951/diffs?diff_id=1175897544&start_sha=9f0260b59a498faa96aa85395ab9e66552fe84b9#37cf1124713138bdefb52ab3ab034ddabfc25b55_314_315)

Indeed, thanks for the hint!

This part has been removed while addressing Jaap's comment.
